source.title: Londonderry Sentinel, 7 June 1967, p. 17 ("Notice of Result of Elections 1967")
source.publisher: Londonderry Sentinel (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: returned unopposed: named as duly elected in the Returning Officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections 1967' (Londonderry Sentinel, 7 June 1967, p. 17)

note: Election of county councillors for the County of Londonderry, polled Thursday 1 June 1967 with the rural district elections (Londonderry Sentinel, 31 May 1967, p. 21, advertises the Middle Liberties R.D.C. election 'to-morrow (Thursday), June 1'; the county result was declared on 2 June, Sentinel, 7 June 1967, p. 10). Dungiven was the only contest; the Returning Officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections 1967' (Sentinel, 7 June 1967, p. 17) names the other eighteen members returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
